annotation.title_clean: Promoting gender equality in science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM) education and careers
annotation.title_en: Promoting gender equality in science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM) education and careers
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 67/137
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament resolution urging the Commission and Member States to close the gender gap in STEM education and careers through stereotype removal, mentoring, funding, anti-harassment policies and entrepreneurship support. It also addresses gender bias in AI, calling for diverse development teams and human oversight. Robotics appears only as a school subject.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls on Member States to include STEM gender equality in national action plans with incentives
Urges zero-tolerance sexual harassment policies and mentoring schemes
AI must not reinforce gender bias; calls for diverse developer teams and gender-expert human oversight before high-risk rollout
Calls for funding access for women entrepreneurs and gender-disaggregated data
Urges integrating robotics and coding early in education
